headword: {受験勉強|じゅけんべんきょう}
gloss: exam preparation, studying for entrance exams

definitions.gloss: exam preparation, studying for entrance exams
definitions.explanation: The process of studying specifically to prepare for entrance examinations, especially for high school or university.

⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{夜遅|よるおそ}く⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{受験勉強|じゅけんべんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm studying for exams until late at night every day.

examples.japanese: {受験勉強|じゅけんべんきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引退|いんたい}→引退：01848_intai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{受験勉強|じゅけんべんきょう} is a compound of ⟦{受験|じゅけん}→受験：04272_juken⟧ (taking an exam) and ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧ (studying).

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has a highly competitive entrance exam system, and {受験勉強|じゅけんべんきょう} often involves intensive studying at cram schools (⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧).
